_comment: Alert subscribers. Schema per subscriber: id (string, unique), channel (telegram|email|webhook), destination (telegram chat_id | email address | webhook URL), tier (free|pro|team), rules (list of rule_ids from alerts/rules.py, or ["*"] for all), min_severity (INFO|WARNING|CRITICAL — subscriber receives events at or above this). Secrets (bot tokens, SMTP creds) come from environment variables, never from this file. A subscriber only receives alerts when "enabled": true (safety default; examples ship disabled).
